Class DocumentForm

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
be.henallux.project.view.DocumentForm
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
public class DocumentForm extends JPanel
DocumentForm represents the Form panel for creating and modifying a Document.

This form allows the user to enter all required information related to a document (dates, workflow, client/supplier, address, etc.).

The form communicates with DocumentController to perform creation and update operations.

    • buildFormPanel

      private JScrollPane buildFormPanel()
      Constructs and returns the main form panel containing two subpanels. The panel is organized using a GridLayout with two columns and a horizontal gap of 20 pixels. Using a JScrollPane for automatic adaptation to window resizing
      Returns:
      a JScrollPanel containing all elements.

    • buildLeftPanel

      private JPanel buildLeftPanel()
      Builds and returns the left section of the document form. This panel contains general document information such as document type, commentary, planned/effective dates, payment delay, and validation check. Required fields are marked with * using ViewUtils.labeledRequired(String, JComponent). Some inputs include validation constraints such as numeric-only fields using ViewUtils.digitsOnly(JTextField).
      Returns:
      the left panel of the document form

    • buildRightPanel

      private JPanel buildRightPanel()
      Builds and returns the right section of the form. This panel contains two grouped sections:
      • Workflow information: Workflow status, Workflow type.
      • Address information: street, street number, postal code, city, and country.
      Some fields include predefined values, such as the non-editable country field or restrictions such as numeric spinners for address and loyalty data.
      Returns:
      the right form panel

    • buildButtonPanel

      private JPanel buildButtonPanel()

    • validateForm

      private boolean validateForm()
      Validates the form fields before submission. Checks that all required fields are filled and follow the rules imposed to correctly fill out the database. The check requirement use typeRequirement(List, String) If a validation rule fails, a warning dialog is displayed and the method returns false.
      Returns:
      true if all validation rules pass; false otherwise

    • typeRequirement

      private boolean typeRequirement(List<DocumentType> list, String typeName)
      Checks the list of document types contains an element whose name matches the specified type name. The comparison is case-insensitive.
      Parameters:
      list - the list of DocumentType to search through
      typeName - the name of the document type to look for
      Returns:
      true if a matching document type is found, false otherwise

    • getSelectedTypeName

    • saveEditForm

      private void saveEditForm()
      Validates the form and saves a document. This method first calls validateForm() to ensure all required fields are correctly filled. If the form is valid, all values are collected and sent to the controller to either create a new document or update field by field an existing one depending on whether currentDocument is null. After a successful save, a confirmation message is displayed and the view is closed via MainWindow.goBack(). In case of errors, a JDialog is displayed with the error message.

    • clearForm

      public void clearForm()
      Resets all input fields in the form to their default values.

    • loadDocument

      public void loadDocument(Document doc)
      Loads a document into the form. If doc is null, the form is reset and switched to create mode. Otherwise, all document data is displayed in the form and the interface is updated to edit mode.
      Parameters:
      doc - the document to display; null to initialize the form in creation mode
      See Also:

    • onNewClientClicked

      public void onNewClientClicked()
      Opens a modal dialog to create a new Client/Supplier and updates the combo box.

      If a new client is created, it is added to the internal list and immediately selected in the combo box.
